rule: R6 — one line base for lines; R6's sibling here is dimension 9 of reviews/LANE-AUDIT-FORMULA.md: an analyzer's time-complexity envelope must be a measurement
purpose: M12's complexityContract requires `declared_budget_per_analyzer` and an envelope that carries its own frame; verify-m12-final-audit.ts asks only whether the artifact EXISTS, so 39 lanes' envelope cell reads green on a number #909 already ruled unscorable. This register makes the class un-recurrable (a lane that gets worse, or a new lane arriving with a claim, fails) while the debt is a worklist.

statuses.open: measured and reported; the lane's envelope is not yet a scored measurement
statuses.paid: within its declared budget with a complete frame — a paid entry that regresses FAILS
statuses.ruled: an owner ruling recorded here with the measurement behind it

staging.current: unadjudicated debt is PRINTED as a worklist; the gate hard-fails only on a lane getting WORSE, a registered artifact vanishing, a paid entry regressing, a registered lane disappearing, and an unregistered lane arriving with a timed, declared budget
staging.why: the census is new and 39 of 41 lanes carry the debt; failing on it on day one would be the mirror of the 'gate that cannot fail' class this program keeps finding
staging.next: once every lane carries a scored row, the worklist becomes a hard failure

improvementsRequireStrict: an improvement is printed and requires --strict to fail; the register must be re-emitted in the same commit that improves a lane
notBuilt: the static quadratic-shape census (repeated full-tree queries inside a visitor, and per-symbol linear scans over symbol/relationship arrays) — owner-named in reviews/m60-oo-family-plan.md §3.7/R6, still absent
per-1k-node normalization: no complexity artifact in this repo records a node count, so ms/1k nodes — the number the formula compares against a sibling language — cannot be derived from any of them
a fixed size band for cross-lane comparison (the C audit's 8-40 KB band is a probe at script/m14/tmp/c-audit-band.ts, not an artifact)

_meta.growthRule: a severity increase, a vanished artifact, a regression out of `paid`, or an unregistered lane with a claim fails the gate; growth is never absorbed into the baseline
_meta.seededFrom: the first census run at this commit; every entry's verdict is the census's own reading, not a hand ruling
